hint.origolds_ar.connector_useful: Allows you to connect two blocks using wireless Redstone
hint.origolds_ar.connector_details:
While holding the item, press Shift+Middle-click to toggle the wireless Redstone display mode.
The following actions only take effect while the wireless Redstone display mode is on:
Shift+Left-click selects the start point and Shift+Right-click selects the end point to create a one-way wireless Redstone link.
Hover the crosshair over a link to select it; press Delete to remove it or Backspace to reverse its direction.
Press Ctrl+Z or Ctrl+Y to undo or redo actions of this mode.
tooltip.origolds_ar.wireless_connector_q: “This is the kind of modern Redstone technology I’ve been looking for.”
tooltip.origolds_ar.remote_switch:
Allows you to connect to a specific block.
Shift+Left-click to bind a block; using the item checks the properties of the bound block.
If it is an interactable block (like a lever or button), the item interacts with it.
If it is a standard block, using the item triggers a Redstone signal from that block, and using it again turns the signal off.
While holding the item, press Sneak+Middle-click to toggle the remote control display mode.
In display mode, you can hover your mouse over a binding indicator to select it.
Press Delete to remove the selected binding indicator.
Press Ctrl+Z or Ctrl+Y while holding the item to undo or redo actions.
tooltip.origolds_ar.remote_switch_quote: “It’s basically just a reskinned TV remote—except what it controls isn’t necessarily a TV.”
